name: Big Mike's Burger
kurzbeschreibung:
**Big Mike’s Burger in Neustift im Stubaital**

Welcome to **Big Mike’s Burger**, your ultimate burger joint nestled in the heart of **Neustift im Stubaital**—where fresh, mouthwatering burgers meet the crisp mountain air of **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a classic cheeseburger, a juicy bacon double, or one of our signature creations, every bite is made with the finest local ingredients.

After your meal, take a short stroll to explore the charming village or head up to the **Stubai Glacier** for breathtaking alpine views. **Big Mike’s Burger**—where great food and adventure collide!

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Opening Hours:**
Mon–Fri: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
Sat–Sun: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM

**Must-Try:**
- **Big Mike’s Classic** – Juicy beef, crisp lettuce, and tangy sauce
- **Tiroler Special** – Smoked beef with **Kaiserschmarrn** crumbles
- **Spicy Stubai** – Chili-kissed burger with a kick

Come hungry, leave happy—**Big Mike’s Burger** awaits! 🍔⛰️
